value.rationale: The regular octagon is a canonical highly symmetric non-Hilbertian, non-square polygonal Banach plane. The defining paper calibrates \(T_G\) at the Hilbert and square endpoints but leaves intermediate polygonal geometry unresolved. The exact value \(2\sqrt2-1\) supplies a natural benchmark, together with an extremizer and an exact reusable facet method for evaluating this new geometric constant on polyhedral norms.
